messages:
riley: Quick plan idea : run a late-afternoon coffee-cart pop-up to quietly hand over spot-awards next Fri. physical token = seeded wildflower packet + digital badge delivered after payroll. low-key, 2-3 min stops at pods. who can own logistics?
jamal: I can coordinate the cart route and barista slot. prefer 3:30pm start. need final names + desk locations by Wed EOD.
zoe: finance ok for $150 cart budget and up to $200 for expedited international seeds. reminder: any award amounts >$100 count as taxable.
marta: I can assemble seed packets and sticker cards Wed morning. can we standardize a 1-line reason on card? keeps notes short.
riley: yes 1-line reason + signer name. we'll have a short script: "congrats, for X, quick seed packet + badge". keep it under 90s.
payroll-bot: Reminder: spot-award payroll submission deadline in 4 business days. submit via payroll portal to avoid delays.
jamal: for remote folks, we will ship seed packets. marta, can you prepare a small ship pack template?
marta: will do. shipping plan: domestic USPS priority, small intl via partner courier listed in ops doc. need addresses by Thu noon.
zoe: confirm per-person award amount in the sheet so I can calculate tax withholding. also please flag any manager exceptions.
riley: sheet link (fill col H for "pickup preference" and col I for "badge or badgeless"): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1CoffeeCart-PopUp (please update)
jamal: cart route plan snippet:
```
- 3:30pm start at main lobby
- hit pods A-C by 3:45pm
- satellite desks 4:00pm
- wrap by 4:30pm
```
marta: packing checklist for assembly team:
```
- 1 seeded packet + protective sleeve
- 1 printed sticker card with 1-line reason
- 1 'do not photo' note optional
- tuck receipt copy for finance
```
zoe: payroll-bot note: ensure amounts exported with employee IDs for payroll import. I will do a quick QA once file is uploaded.
riley: volunteers: jamal cart lead, marta assembly + shipping, zoe payroll/QA, riley messaging and recipients DM.
jamal: can someone bring a small chalkboard sign for the cart that says 'quiet congrats'? keeps vibe low-key.
marta: i'll bring sign and hand sanitizer.
zoe: final action items: 1) riley finalize recipients Wed noon, 2) marta assemble Wed morning, 3) jamal confirm barista by Thu, 4) payroll export to zoe by Thu EOD.
riley: agreed. please respect privacy choices in the sheet (no-photo / desk-pickup). thanks team :)
